# <Pattern name>

## Context
Which screens this is for, stated as decision-table inputs: content relationship, interaction mode. One example from the corpus, one from Apple's apps.

## Forces
The tensions this pattern resolves (reach vs. space, continuity vs. use of the second half, system displacement vs. product rules). Three to five bullets; each must be a real conflict, not a benefit.

## Solution
Per pose, what goes where. Table: pose → primary pane, secondary pane, bars, sheets/alerts. Every row cites `[apple-apps/…]` or `[metrics:…]`.

## Consequences
What you give up. What breaks if the content relationship is misjudged. Measured thresholds (minimum pane widths) with their source.

## Known uses
Apple app + pose + screenshot path. Corpus app before/after.

## When not to use it
The adjacent pattern that fits instead and the input that distinguishes them.
